messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock sprint scope for a constrained pilot of the Optimize recommendations (batching / caching / quant suggestions + eval-triggered alerts). Can we realistically ship something meaningful in 2 sprints? Who's in?

Raj: We can do a minimal vertical: batching + cache recommendations + eval alerts for regressions in 2 sprints if we scope quant to recommendations-only (no auto-quant on-ramp). Quant runtime work needs extra kernel/ops time.

Lina: Agree on scope. Telemetry we need before pilot: tokens_saved_total, p95/p99 latency delta, model-hallucination proxy (eval mismatch rate), and alert counts. For eval-alert thresholds I'll need baseline percentiles per-customer. Example query to start with:
```
sum(rate(tokens_saved_total[1h])) by (customer)
max(rate(eval_mismatch_total[1h])) by (customer)
```

Mateo: Platform notes: deps are 1) SDK feature flag to opt-in customers, 2) console tile for recommendations and alert config, 3) webhook endpoint support for eval alerts. We can reuse the feature-flag infra from Dedicated rollouts. Owners: SDK = Mateo, Console = Priya fronting eng work, Flags = Raj.

Priya: Customer asks summary: ACME wants auto-quant suggestions + evidence (latency/cost tradeoffs). Nova wants eval alerts to their monitoring webhook. For pilot we should offer manual quant suggestions (report + recommended profile) + alert webhooks. That keeps runtime risk low.

Jorge: Proposed acceptance criteria for pilot (must pass to go to canary):
- Quality: <= 3% degradation on customer eval set (by F1/accuracy as applicable)
- Latency: p95 increase <= 20ms (or absolute p95 < customer SLO)
- Economics: >= 15% tokens or cost reduction on batchy workloads
If any fail we hold and iterate.

Maya: Nice. My suggested gating: alpha pilot (3 customers) -> internal canary (10%) -> gradual 25% -> 100%. Alpha must pass Jorge's acceptance criteria and have instrumentation we can query from Console.

Raj: Implementation sketch: batching: customer-level dynamic batching with per-tenant batch cap + backpressure hook to preserve p95. Cache: prefix/KV hints surfaced as "recommend cacheable" suggestions. Quant: offline profiler that recommends quantization levels and expected cost/latency delta. Eval alerts: hook that compares rolling eval to baseline and fires to webhook when threshold exceeded. I'll drop a short design doc in #eng-runtime tomorrow.

Lina: I'll own the eval harness and thresholds. Need sample prompt sets and golden outputs from pilot customers by EOD Friday to calibrate baselines. Also adding a watchlist for false-positive alerts.

Maya: Action items (owners / due):
- Raj: post design + rough effort estimate (by Tue)
- Mateo: SDK flag + webhook capability plan (by Wed)
- Priya: console mockups for recommendations + alert config (by Wed)
- Lina: eval harness + threshold proposal (by Fri)
- Jorge: write acceptance test checklist (by Fri)

If we hit these, we can commit the scope for the sprint. Thumbs if good + add any blockers now. :thumbsup:

Raj: +1
